findings.title: Fixed inventory omits the preserved successor-test fixture closure
findings.evidence: The owner map at line 138 explicitly preserves successor-contract.json, successor-contract-type.ts, successor-test-context.ts, temporary-repository-harness.mjs, controlled-freeze-successor.mjs, the historical routing analyzer, and its self-test fixtures. The successor test imports this closure directly, but derivation adds neither that directory nor those files; inventory.json contains no phase-3a1b-freeze-successor-v1 fixture record. Consequently the prospective root manifest would protect the editable successor test while leaving its historical oracle, harness, and analyzer inputs mutable.
findings.violated_requirement: Complete fixed inventory; historical-test supersession without suppression; preservation of historical controlled models and evidence

findings.title: Inventory collapses current semantic inputs and historical evidence into one role
findings.evidence: README.md lines 92-95 require every path to be explicitly classified as an editable current owner, preserved current semantic input, preserved historical evidence, or new RED evidence. Derivation instead emits the single classification preserved-input for both live semantic sources such as CODEOWNERS (inventory.json line 284) and retired historical authorities such as freeze-successor-v1/check-freeze.mjs (line 488), delegating the distinction to prose in the owner map. The frozen inventory therefore cannot itself enforce the promised current-versus-historical role boundary.
findings.violated_requirement: Complete role-classified inventory; explicit historical-versus-current authority disposition

findings.title: Strict compiler baseline has an impossible RED release ordering
findings.evidence: Lines 13-15 and 32 require the compiler baseline after the new RED files exist and before GREEN edits. Lines 38-39 then require any selected-root baseline errors to be dispositioned before RED release. The selected roots include the proposed RED test and helpers, so they cannot exist or be compiled before the RED implementation owner is released. The gate must instead block RED acceptance/hand-off to GREEN, or explicitly run after RED implementation and before GREEN release.
findings.violated_requirement: Implementable separate RED/GREEN staging with fresh strict compiler provenance
